mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns, and this condition is always met in the current economic environment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% signals inflationary pressure that leads to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns as the market prices in potential monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 550 thousand units) signals a supportive monetary policy and strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND HOUST > 550) is met in more than 40% of cases, but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.5%), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive 20-day forward returns as the market anticipates eventual monetary policy easing and economic recovery.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 9.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently high level of housing starts (HOUST > 550 thousand units) is associated with positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns, and this condition is always met in the current economic environment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when HOUST > 550.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 350 billion dollars signals a weakening consumer sector, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns as the market prices in potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 350,000.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals an economic slowdown and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns as the market anticipates policy responses.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (INDPRO < 100 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) is met in more than 40% of cases, but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 tends to produce positive 60-day forward returns as the market prices in potential policy interventions and eventual recovery.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO < 100, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
